labels.rule: 月份与保守区间 [start,end] 有重叠即受限；宽松区间 [start,loose_until] 作敏感性；受限月销量是下限观测

routes.raw: ridge on log1p(y), all months weighted 1
routes.censored: ridge on log1p(y) with one-sided lower-censored loss: a prediction below the observed restricted value costs 0, above it costs the usual squared loss (IRLS, 6 iterations)
